Rhonda sipped her tea and ran a hand through the mess of her uncombed curls. “I have to fly to Washington,” she said.
“That’s quite extravagant,” Emily replied on cue.”What gives?”
This was a gimme. Emily was lucky that “extravagant” had slipped right into the sentence. Rhonda pushed the reset button on her timer and glanced down at the crumpled piece of paper spread carefully on the tabletop. Her own next code word was induction. In fifty-seven seconds, she had to work the word “induction” into a sentence.
“Do you remember Anand Klein?”
“Of course, I remember him.” Emily shrugged. Her image on the screen froze mid-shrug, but her voice was still coming through. “A complete nerd in school, but he made it big. I heard he was like a colonel in the Crypto Mining Force.”
